verdict.rationale: RevenueCat ships a built-in AI assistant, Rico, which answers plain-language analytics questions such as "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?" with data-driven answers. The product also offers built-in AI-prompt paywall generation and editing. The MCP server and AI Toolkit serve external agents, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence that Rico can take actions beyond analysis (e.g., configuring products or entitlements in-dashboard), detailed docs on the assistant's scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
